recommendation.runtimeFile: OWN FILE (synthetic-bot-runtime.js) ΓÇö do not fold into crypto-bot-runtime.js. Probe shows designed fixed-vol ATR-ratio profiles that differ across Volatility Index variants; ┬º3 no-news-correlation is a hard architectural difference from crypto's shock-news pipeline; surface 24/7 similarity alone is not enough to share a dispatcher.
recommendation.instrumentScopeFirstCut: Start with continuous Volatility Indices only (standard tick cadence). Defer Boom/Crash/Jump (spike design). Treat 1s variants as a separate sub-watchlist ΓÇö higher designed frequency, different spread/volume_min profile.
recommendation.thresholds: Ratio p10/p90 collapses to ~0.95/1.05 across all Volatility Index variants in this window ΓÇö designed-fixed vol makes the ATR-ratio nearly stationary. Per-symbol differentiation shows up in absolute ATR (% of price), volume_min, and spread, not in the ratio cutoffs. First-cut ratio bands may therefore be shared within the Volatility Index family, with per-symbol Module 7 specs. Flagged for report-before-build: ratio-based HIGH/LOW may be the wrong primary regime axis for these instruments.
recommendation.strategyTransfer: See per-symbol strategyFit verdicts ΓÇö EMA/breakout/RSI assessed independently. Breakout primary verdict uses unmodified forex 0.8/1.3 bands.
